title: Product writing assistant verified with OpenAI
summary: Product writing drafts work through the configured OpenAI connection; local route and interaction checks passed.

changes.detail: Expandable writing assistant with facts input, three tones, generated preview and separate apply buttons. Existing form facts are included; new product slugs update when applying a name. Editing an existing product preserves its URL.

Admin-authorized same-origin rate-limited endpoint using existing server-only OpenAI Responses integration. Input/output validation, bounded request sizes, timeout and safe configuration/billing errors. No automatic database writes; API key never reaches browser.
General information form now includes AI writing before the description field. Prompt restricts output to supplied facts and rejects internal inventory tags.
Explicit JSON instruction in the input message resolves the initial live provider rejection. Added regression assertion and setup/usage documentation.

validation.name: Automated route and interaction tests
validation.detail: Six local tests cover draft fields, authorization/rate-limit short-circuiting, validation, malformed output, explicit per-field application and error handling.

validation.name: Live synthetic OpenAI generation
validation.detail: All seven tests passed with TEST_PRODUCT_WRITING_LIVE=1 after the JSON input correction, including a real synthetic 30-litre sports bag draft. No real product was saved.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: Full repository tsc --noEmit --incremental false passed. Focused lint for product editor, writing assistant and route passed without warnings or errors.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Append and manifest checks passed; initial failure report and all prior reports retained.

validation.name: Browser and deployment
validation.detail: No connected browser for visual/authenticated end-to-end verification. No deployment performed. Local API key configuration does not prove production environment configuration.
